title: Example: Mnemuron OpenClaw Adapter v0.1
goal: Example task: validate the OpenClaw adapter with your own isolated service and agent identity.
decisions: OpenClaw uses an independent API credential and the identity openclaw-example on device openclaw-host.
OpenClaw events use workstream-openclaw and never overwrite canonical task state.
Telegram /mnemuron continue only creates a Resume Preview; confirmation requires the exact resume ID and version in a later message.
A confirmed Resume Packet is injected once into the next OpenClaw turn and acknowledged only after successful agent completion.
Command Sessions and full Telegram Agent Sessions are matched through a channel-scoped chat identity so Packets cannot cross chats.
blockers: Example seed only; deployment-specific acceptance evidence has not been recorded.
next_steps: Configure isolated service and client identities for this example.
Run the documented acceptance checks and record actual results before marking the task complete.
